#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;
    std::vector<int> arr(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> arr[i];
    }
    if ((n & 1) == 1) {
        cout << 0;
        return 0;
    }

    std::unordered_map<int, int> map;
    int ec = 0, oc = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (arr[i] % 2 == 0)
            ec++;
        else
            oc++;
        if (ec > 0 && oc > 0 && ec == oc && i + 1 < n) {
            map[i] = abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]);
        }
    }

    if (map.size() == 0) {
        cout << 0;
        return 0;
    } else if (map.size() == 1) {
        std::vector<int> list;
        for (const auto& kv : map) {
            list.push_back(kv.second);
        }
        if (list[0] <= b) {
            cout << 1;
            return 0;
        } else {
            cout << 0;
            return 0;
        }
    } else {
        std::vector<int> list;
        for (const auto& kv : map) {
            list.push_back(kv.second);
        }
        std::sort(list.begin(), list.end());
        int k = 0;
        while (k < (int)list.size()) {
            if (list[k] <= b) {
                b -= list[k];
                k++;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        cout << k;
        return 0;
    }

}
